profile.headline: Lead QA and Software Engineer | Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)
profile.geoLocationName: New York, New York, United States
profile.summary:
As a Senior SDET and Software Engineer with 12 years of experience, I specialize in designing and deploying full-stack solutions to enhance software quality and operational efficiency. At my current company, I developed a robust portfolio platform combining a responsive frontend with a Spring Boot REST API hosted on Google Cloud Run, ensuring seamless user experiences and secure workflows.  

My work includes building and maintaining a Playwright automation suite with over 200 tests, covering UI workflows, API validation, accessibility checks, and visual regression testing. By implementing CI/CD pipelines via GitHub Actions, I facilitate continuous integration and delivery of static frontend and backend deployments. My core competencies include the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), back-end operations, and Python, which I leverage to drive innovation and collaboration within dynamic team environments.

positions.title: Lead QA and Software Engineer
positions.description:
Designed and deployed a full-stack portfolio platform combining a responsive frontend (HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Bootstrap) with a Spring Boot REST API hosted on Google Cloud Run, integrating GitHub project data, analytics endpoints, and secure contact workflows.

Built and maintained a Playwright automation suite (200+ tests across 30+ spec files) covering UI workflows, API validation, accessibility checks, visual regression, and end-to-end user journeys across multiple browsers and mobile viewports.

Implemented CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions to run automated tests on pull requests, manage visual snapshot updates, maintain selectors, and deploy the static frontend and backend API based on repository changes.

Designed REST endpoints for project metadata, GitHub activity, analytics, and contact services with global error handling, CORS configuration, and OpenAPI documentation to support maintainable API contracts and reliable integrations.
positions.insights: Skills: Java · Back-end Operations · Front-End Development · Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC)

positions.title: Quality Assurance Developer
positions.description:
Developed and deployed a portfolio platform with a Spring Boot API, integrating GitHub data, multilingual support, and secure contact forms, while validating API behavior, accessibility, and reliability. 
Designed and maintained a Playwright end-to-end automation suite (190+ tests) for the client-side SPA covering navigation, forms, projects, blog, translations, and API-backed workflows across Chromium, Firefox, and mobile viewports, which caught UI defects early and kept test reliability high. Enhanced backend test coverage and reliability across browsers and devices by implementing Playwright API tests and SPA-focused strategies, cutting flaky CI runs by over 50%. 
Expanded automated coverage to include accessibility (WCAG), i18n (EN/ES), visual regression, and error-handling scenarios, and integrated the suite into GitHub Actions CI with parallel execution, visual snapshot workflows, and documented stability improvements through post-mortems and testing guides. 
Implemented a QA process using Test Management Tools and Agile ceremonies, creating clear test plans and regular review checkpoints; this increased early defect detection and reduced rework time across development cycles.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Owned all testing activities, including planning, test design, execution, and regression, for backend REST APIs and service workflows in an Agile/Scrum environment, improving system reliability and enabling faster feature delivery for the SaaS healthcare platform. 
Automated API, integration, and data-validation workflows using Pytest, Playwright, Postman, and custom Python utilities, significantly reducing manual regression cycles and increasing release confidence. 
Integrated automated validation into CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions and Jenkins, managing test artifacts in Zephyr and enabling continuous testing, reliable environment promotion, and rapid defect detection across services. 
Implemented design patterns and algorithmic solutions to optimize API performance and reliability, and designed high-volume data load tests that pushed realistic "fake" data through critical endpoints to stress test the system, uncovering bottlenecks and ensuring delivery of high-performance backend services. 
Designed and maintained Robot Framework suites for end-to-end and integration testing of backend workflows and APIs, improving coverage and enabling faster, more reliable validation across critical Medidata applications.

positions.title: Senior Software Development Engineer in Test
positions.description:
- Designed, implemented, and maintained automated tests for web APIs and UI workflows using Robot Framework and Python, reducing manual effort by 70%, and created robust internal libraries to ensure reusable, modular test architecture across teams.
- Shifted testing left by integrating automated pipelines in GitHub Actions and CI/CD workflows, collaborating across Agile teams and time zones.
- AI-assisted test case generation and defect triage using Amazon Q to improve test coverage and reduce authoring time.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Developed and maintained scalable backend services in Python, Java and Go, integrating APIs and Bash scripts to enable real-time security analytics, which reduced data processing latency. Collaborated with product and engineering teams using JIRA to define requirements and delivered new features that improved system throughput by 15%. Implemented automated testing pipelines with Pytest and CI/CD integration for reliable deployments. Enhanced code quality through code reviews and standardized coding guidelines in Git, which lowered the number of bugs reaching production.

positions.title: Network Automation Developer
positions.description:
▪	Developed dynamic web applications and scripts in Python + Jinja2, PERL, PHP, JavaScript and the standard markup languages, HTML and CSS, to improve efficiency through every-day operations.
▪	Automated functionalities of various network processes through the planning and development of various tools for network automation to reduce and facilitate daily network maintenance tasks.
▪	Applications queried databases to create reusable data across various tools and reports. 
▪	Created scripts in different languages to perform automatic data manipulation.
▪	Developed and maintained modules to abstract the complexity of developing tools by any Global Network Services member.
▪	Performed firm-wide automation tools used across various teams (locally and globally)
▪	Created documentation for programs written to detail proper usage.

positions.title: Network Engineer
positions.description:
Engineered Python and Perl scripts and an internal library for F5 devices to automate network data extraction, validation, and monitoring for high-frequency financial trading infrastructure, significantly reducing manual workload and errors for the engineering team.
Troubleshot, maintained, and enhanced legacy networking tools to ensure continued functionality and optimized performance for critical backend systems. 
Planned, implemented, tested, and deployed network automation software in close collaboration with the network team, applying software quality assurance principles to validate data accuracy and application behavior, which improved reliability of network monitoring and reporting.

positions.title: Technology Specialist Intern
positions.description:
▪	Acted as the First Point of Contact for employees and students.
▪	Implemented various policies to facilitate the movement and integrity of equipment.
▪	Re-designed and maintained school’s website to reflect current school announcements, events and newsletters.
▪	Configured 200+ technological assets to systems (JAMF & Neverware) to administer and track various technologies.

•	Provided bi-weekly written reports of progress and activities completed.

projects.title: Ticket Create, Edit, Lookup
projects.description: Developed tool to keep track of tickets that were open by the Network team for all Cisco, Radware, F5, CheckPoint etc. hardware. The tool allowed for creating new tickets, editing existing tickets and looking up tickets through search fields that the user filled out. All ticket operations were conducted through the querying of a database and populating the page with results

projects.title: Vendor Lookup Tool
projects.description: Developed dynamic tool the lookup Tradeweb vendors by querying database for results that match criteria entered by the user. Using JavaScript, fields were able to be dynamically added. All inputs , including dynamically generated ones, were sent using PHP and the values of the inputs were sent to the database to return matching results.
